description: Defines constants, structures, enums, and flags related to NTLM authentication protocol, including security buffers, message types, negotiate flags, and AV pairs.

classes.name: SecurityBuffer
classes.description: Represents a security buffer within an NTLM message, indicating payload offset and length.

classes.name: NtlmFeatures
classes.description: Encapsulates NTLM feature flags such as NTLMv2, MIC, and EPA.

classes.name: AvPair
classes.description: Represents an AV Pair structure within NTLM target info, including type, length, and payload buffer.

methods.name: operator|
methods.description: Bitwise OR operator for NegotiateFlags and TargetInfoAvFlags enums.

methods.name: operator&
methods.description: Bitwise AND operator for NegotiateFlags and TargetInfoAvFlags enums.
